mails.subject: Fwd: meetup idea, worth a look
mails.body:
FYI, this looks like a good fit for November, can you reply to Anders?

From: Anders Wolff <anders@pixelpub.example>
We run a monthly indie game dev meetup (about 30 people) and need a new home from November. Would you host us on a Thursday evening?
mails.justification: A third party proposes hosting a monthly meetup starting next month, forwarded with a one-line comment.

mails.subject: Saturday setup for Tuesday's panel
mails.body:
Hi team,

Sorry for writing so late on a Saturday. I'm organising the panel on sustainable packaging this Tuesday evening at 18:00, and the numbers look bigger than planned, 60 people instead of 40.

Could we swap the small event room for the main hall? If that is taken, we would need around 20 extra chairs in the current room.

We also need two handheld microphones, the projector and a clicker for the slides. I can come on Tuesday at 15:00 to set up with a colleague.

Could you let me know by Monday what is possible, so I can update the invitation?

Thank you very much,
Noor Hassan
Thursday Talks
mails.justification: An organiser asks for room change, chairs and AV for an event this week, needing an answer within 24 hours.

mails.subject: Cancellation of meeting room booking, Thursday 1 October
mails.body:

mails.subject: Re: Your enquiry about meeting rooms
mails.body:
> Thanks for getting in touch, can you tell us what date you have in mind?

We don't have a date yet, probably sometime in November. Do you rent a room for a full day to non-members? Also, is there a trial day for a desk if we like it? Leila

mails.subject: Samarbejde? Kaffe + jeres rum ☕
mails.body:
Hej allesammen 👋

Vi er Kaffekollektivet, et lille ristet-kaffe-firma på Vesterbro. Vi elsker jeres rum og tænkte, om vi kunne lave en sponsoraftale?

Vi leverer gratis kaffe og bønner til jeres fælleskøkken i hele november og december, og til gengæld sætter vi vores logo op ved kaffemaskinen og nævner jer i vores nyhedsbrev. Vi kunne også lave en lille smagning for medlemmerne 🎉

Hvad siger I? Vi kan tage en snak over en kop kaffe, når det passer jer.

Bedste hilsner
Freja og Mads
mails.justification: An organisation proposes sponsorship with logo and newsletter mention, a collaboration proposal with no deadline.

mails.subject: Constant noise from the open area next to desk 14
mails.body:
Hello,

I am a member with a fixed desk (no. 14) and I want to flag a problem that has been getting worse for about three weeks. The area next to my desk is used more and more for phone calls and informal meetings, and from around 10:00 to 15:00 the noise level makes it very hard to work.

I have spoken to a couple of the people involved and they were polite but nothing has changed. I do not think it is anybody's fault, it is a layout issue.

Could you consider one or more of the following: a rule for calls in the open area, moving the standing meeting table to the other side of the room, or putting up an acoustic panel? I would also be happy to move to another desk if one is free.

I work on client reports with tight deadlines, so I would appreciate an answer this week, and some action soon.

Thanks in advance,
Henrik Sloth
Desk 14, Sloth Analytics
mails.justification: A member reports ongoing noise and asks for a fix this week, so a complaint needing an answer within 24 hours.

mails.subject: LOCKED OUT - card not working
mails.body:
Hi,

Im standing outside the main door and my access card is not working, the light stays red. I have a client workshop in the big room starting at 9:00 and 12 people are arriving soon.

I also booked the big room for 9-13 today and the confirmation is in my email, so it should be open for me. Please can someone let me in or call me asap, 55 07 66 41?? I tried the buzzer twice no answer.

Thanks!!
Anita
Sent from my phone
mails.justification: A member is locked out right now with a client workshop starting, a security and access issue needing action today, mentioning a room booking.

mails.subject: Faktura 3318 og manglende kvittering
mails.body:
Hej,

Jeg har fået faktura 3318 på 2.400 DKK for oktober, men jeg tror, der er sket en fejl. Jeg har kun et flexskrivebord, som koster 1.800 DKK, og så er der de 600 DKK, som jeg ikke kan genkende.

Jeg kan se, at 600 DKK passer til et møderum i september, men det blev allerede betalt med kort på dagen, og jeg har en kvittering fra kortbetalingen med dato 14. september.

Kan I tjekke, om beløbet er faktureret to gange? Hvis ja, vil jeg gerne have en rettet faktura.

Jeg har også brug for, at jeg får en samlet kvittering for hele september til min bogholder, som skal bruge den til momsangivelsen i næste uge.

Jeg kan ellers sende et skærmbillede af kortbetalingen.

Tak på forhånd,
Stine Borup
Borup Consult
mails.justification: A member questions a possible double-charged invoice and asks for a receipt, a billing question needing a reply within a day or so.

mails.subject: Le Bulletin d'octobre : ce qui bouge dans le quartier
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Voici le bulletin d'octobre, que vous recevez parce que vous êtes inscrit à notre liste.

Cette semaine : le marché de producteurs du dimanche reprend sur la place, de 9 h à 14 h. Les pistes cyclables de la rue du Port seront en travaux jusqu'au 20 octobre. Une exposition de photos d'habitants ouvre à la bibliothèque du quartier le 12 octobre.

À noter aussi : la collecte des déchets verts passe désormais le mercredi.

Pour vous désinscrire, utilisez le lien en bas de ce message.

L'équipe du Bulletin
mails.justification: A subscribed local newsletter with no request, so nothing to reply to.
